title: Unified Wikimedia MCP Server — Machine-Readable Test Corpus
description: Concrete, executable-intent test cases for the unified Wikimedia MCP server. Grounded in research reports 01-05: tool groups A-G (report 05 section 2) and success metrics (report 05 section 10). Intended to drive task-corpus success-rate, single-call-resolution, latency, politeness, licensing and actionable-error metrics.

schema.test_cases: Array of test case objects (this file defines >= 30).
schema.case.id: Stable unique identifier, prefixed by tool group (e.g. TC-A-001).
schema.case.tool_group: One of A (Content Retrieval), B (Knowledge Graph/Wikidata), C (Metrics), D (Live/Recent Changes), E (Enterprise/Bulk), F (Media & Commons), G (Advanced/Administrative) per report 05 section 2.
schema.case.tool: Exact MCP tool name as exposed by the server.
schema.case.params: Realistic tool arguments using real titles (Earth, Ada Lovelace, NASA), QIDs (Q42, Q718), project codes (enwiki, dewiki, commonswiki, testwiki) and API dates.
schema.case.category: One of happy_path | edge_case | error | security | resilience.
schema.case.expected.status: One of ok | error | input_required (input_required models MCP 2026-07-28 multi-round-trip / confirmation gating).
schema.case.expected.required_fields: Fields that MUST be present in the result (or error object) for the case to pass. Content cases require source/revision/license/attribution fields to enforce the 100% licensing metric.
schema.case.expected.constraints: Assertions that cannot be expressed as fields (e.g. single-call resolution, p95 latency, politeness, no instruction execution, confirmation before write).
schema.case.mode: live (hit real public APIs) or fixture (replay recorded/synthetic responses). Adverse, destructive and non-deterministic conditions MUST be fixture.
schema.case.notes: Optional rationale, risk link, or metric linkage.

tool_call_success_ge_95.target: >=95% of test_cases resolve without an unexpected tool error
tool_call_success_ge_95.measure: count(expected.status matching observed status and all required_fields present) / total applicable cases

single_call_resolution_ge_70.target: >=70% of task cases resolved with exactly one tools/call
single_call_resolution_ge_70.measure: cases whose constraints contain 'single tool call resolves the task' / total task cases

p95_latency_lt_2s.target: p95 < 2000 ms per tool (excluding network-bound bulk operations)
p95_latency_lt_2s.measure: histogram of tools/call durations across live and fixture runs; bulk groups E/D excluded

rate_limit_429_rate_0.target: 0 HTTP 429 under the standard test load
rate_limit_429_rate_0.measure: count of 429 responses emitted by upstreams during live runs (concurrency <= 3, User-Agent set)

license_attribution_100.target: 100% of content-returning results carry license + attribution fields
license_attribution_100.measure: cases in groups A/F/E with content whose required_fields include license and attribution / all content cases

actionable_quota_errors_100.target: 100% of quota/rate/credential failures return an actionable error
actionable_quota_errors_100.measure: terminal error cases with required_fields including error.code, error.retryable and error.action / all terminal quota cases (TC-E-002, TC-E-004, TC-E-005); TC-A-014 models eventual success after backoff and is measured under tool_call_success_ge_95 and rate_limit_429_rate_0 only, so it is excluded from the actionable_quota_errors_100 denominator
